english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for exertion or an endeavor framed as sustained hard work.
This is the all-purpose noun for sustained effort and the quality of working hard.
Use 努力 when action means the effort invested in doing something.
Use this for the figurative sense of hard work or effort, as in the saying about genius and perspiration.

examples.english: I put a lot of effort into doing the report well.
examples.traditional: 我為咗做好份報告，落咗好多努力。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 wai6 zo2 zou6 hou2 fan6 bou3 gou3 lok6 zo2 hou2 do1 nou5 lik6

examples.english: Learning Cantonese well takes real diligence.
examples.traditional: 想學好廣東話，真係要落啲努力。
examples.jyutping: soeng2 hok6 hou2 gwong2 dung1 waa2 zan1 hai6 jiu3 lok6 di1 nou5 lik6

examples.english: The action you put into this has really produced results.
examples.traditional: 你今次嘅努力真係好有成果。
examples.jyutping: nei5 gam1 ci3 ge3 nou5 lik6 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 sing4 gwo2

examples.english: Success depends not only on talent but also on perspiration.
examples.traditional: 成功唔係淨係靠天分，仲要靠努力。
examples.jyutping: sing4 gung1 m4 hai6 zing6 hai6 kaau3 tin1 fan6 zung6 jiu3 kaau3 nou5 lik6
